description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - day lookback: in the evening, replay the day as an attention timeline - every gaze you registered (a scene, a number, a promise) with its time and the direction you were facing, in time order, filterable by type, then a summary. Session memory only, wiped on close: the timeline lives in this one open session, it is not carried across sessions.
name: day-lookback
